events.title: PAGANS is in Steam Next Fest. Play free and claim Guest Right
events.summary: Steam Next Fest is live, and the PAGANS demo is free to play right now. What's PAGANS? A dark-fantasy strategy card game drawn from Slavic myth. Build a deck of gods, spirits, curses and warriors, then fight short tactical battles over mystical locations. Choose where to commit, when to hold back, and which lane to give up. Matches take minutes, and the decisions are hard ones. What's in the demo? A roguelike run through the Black Forest, ending against Baba Yaga About 200 MB, Windows only Guest

events.title: New card in the making: Wall of Bodies
events.summary: Fallen comrades, stacked into a barricade. That is the idea behind Wall of Bodies, a new Spartan card coming to Pagans.At 3 cost and 4 power, it looks like a solid midrange body. The real bite is the ongoing effect: once it hits a location, that lane locks. No more cards can be played there. Nothing can move in either. You plant it, and the pass is closed.It is a denial tool with teeth. Slam it onto a contested lane after you have already won the fight, or drop it early to force your opponent in

events.title: Spartans are coming! (soon)
events.summary: Most Spartan cards carry the Fated tag.Fated: this card dies when its Power reaches 0 or below.That sounds like a downside. For Sparta, it is the point.Power is not a soft score. When you chip an enemy to nothing, they leave the location. When your own cheap soldiers get drained, sold, or ordered into the spears, they leave too. Death is not flavor text. It is a resource. events.title: Something Is Listening in The Whispering Hut
events.summary: Some curses do not need to last.Soon, Whisperer will join the Slavic collection. This 2-Cost, 2-Power Creature brings more than its own strength to the board. When Whisperer is revealed, it replaces its location with The Whispering Hut. The Whispering Hut is not part of the usual location rotation. Whisperer is the only way to bring it into a match.Once the Hut appears, its effect remains in play. After each turn, it cleanses negative Power changes from every card at that location.
